sources.cad_world_visual_note: The checked-in CAD world STL files are ASCII; they are parsed and audited, while the MuJoCo world uses the table and rigid object primitives.

assumptions.robot_trajectory_mode: kinematic_collision_playback; MuJoCo rigid-body dynamics are used for the free object and release, while uncalibrated arm motor dynamics are excluded
assumptions.joint_position_limits_rad: assumed +/- pi; encoder limits are not measured
assumptions.gripper: CAD collision mesh plus fixed jaw contact proxies; jaw actuator calibration is not measured
assumptions.object_model: primitive rigid bodies with class-specific dimensions and mass from desktop scene specs
assumptions.tissue: rigid sheet-stack proxy; cloth deformation and pull dynamics are not modeled

limitations: MuJoCo contact and dynamics use provisional link density because CAD mass properties are not calibrated.
The ROS2 Xacro declares continuous joints; the regression applies an assumed +/- pi envelope only for offline safety checks.
Static gripper CAD is supplemented by fixed jaw proxies; real jaw width, force, and finger motion remain unverified.
A passed offline trial is not proof of camera calibration, encoder correctness, F407 feedback, grasp force, or real object friction.
Real motion remains locked by hardware_calibration.json and is never enabled by this script.
